name: Marincess Overflow
desc: Target Spells/Traps on the field up to the number of "Marincess" Link Monsters you control; destroy them. You can banish this card from your GY; send 1 Link-3 or higher "Marincess" Link Monster Card you control to the GY, then you can Special Summon 1 WATER Cyberse Ritual Monster from your hand or GY (this is treated as a Ritual Summon). If you control a Link-3 or higher "Marincess" Link Monster, you can activate this card from your hand.
